name: Media Processing & Derivatives
description: Asynchronous pipeline that generates previews/thumbnails, web-optimized derivatives, watermarked variants, video transcodes, and metadata extraction (EXIF/geo/time). Provides CDN-friendly delivery via Cloudflare.
goals: Generate consistent derivative sets for fast browsing and sharing.
Ensure idempotent processing and safe retries.
Support plan-based policies (e.g., max resolution, watermark rules).
Enable downstream AI analysis triggers (labels, face embeddings, captions).

rules: Derivative objects stored under workspace_id prefix.
Processing jobs are workspace-scoped and must not read/write cross-workspace objects.
Processing concurrency and quotas can be enforced per workspace and plan.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Workers process assets and produce derivatives.

workflows.name: Automatic Processing on Asset Ingest
steps: On asset.created event, enqueue extract_metadata and generate_images jobs.
Extract EXIF/metadata; update assets.exif and searchable fields.
Generate thumbnails + preview + web derivative; store records in asset_derivatives.
Optionally enqueue AI analysis jobs (labels/captions/faces) based on workspace settings.
Mark asset status available when minimum derivatives exist.

workflows.name: Video Transcoding
steps: Detect video assets and enqueue transcode_video jobs.
Write derived objects and update derivative table.
Expose signed or CDN URLs to portal.

backgroundJobs.retries: safe retry with idempotent output keys

backgroundJobs.notes: Reconcile orphan derivatives, missing records, and stale running jobs.

logs: Worker logs with job_id + asset_id + workspace_id
traces: End-to-end trace: upload commit -> asset.created -> processing pipeline -> derivative ready

controls: Workers run in isolated pods with least privilege to storage prefixes
Validate file headers/mime sniffing to avoid polyglot attacks
Limit processing resource usage per workspace to prevent noisy-neighbor

acceptanceTests: After upload commit, thumbnails and preview URLs are available for browsing.
Watermarked derivative matches configured watermark profile and is only generated when needed.
Failed processing retries safely without duplicate derivative records.
Derivatives never leak across workspaces (workspace_id enforced in object keys and DB queries).
openQuestions: Do we standardize on imgproxy/thumbor or custom worker pipeline?
Do we store HLS manifests in R2 and serve via CDN directly, or proxy through an origin?
Watermark profile: per gallery, per workspace, or per share link?
